name: Quick Sketch
description: A 15 to 30 second vertical micro-sketch told with characters: one concrete moment an owner knows too well, a beat of reaction, the one Iker thing that handles it, and the call to action. Motion graphics first; a product screenshot scene is optional. Includes a YouTube Shorts cut and a social portrait cut.

scenes.title: The moment
scenes.guidance: One concrete moment from a service business, as it happens: a client says they sent the money with no proof, a walk-in nobody wrote down. Fictional names, no statistics, no fear.

scenes.title: The reaction
scenes.guidance: A beat of reaction: what the owner now has to do or work out. One short sentence or two.

scenes.title: The Iker answer
scenes.guidance: The one thing in Iker that handles this moment, named with the product's own labels. Iker records and tracks; the owner confirms. Swap in a product screenshot here if a real screen says it better, and say it is made-up data.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: One line, the site's own call to action.

scenes.title: The moment
scenes.guidance: The same moment, told for a feed: the line the client says, then what is missing.

scenes.title: The reaction
scenes.guidance: The owner's reaction as a few short lines, ending on the question the video answers.

scenes.title: The Iker answer
scenes.guidance: The one Iker thing that handles it, with the product's own labels. Optional: a product screenshot instead, said to be made-up data.
